body:
Attack/repair:
- `private authority -> public projection only` is underspecified and can form a cycle if Stage slide observation drives private STT/RAG context, which later publishes back to Stage. Make authority field-specific, not plane-wide: Stage/viewer is authoritative only for `(deckVersion, slideId, slideSeq)` observation; session service for controller lease/command outcome; publish service for audience cards/tombstones. Observations may flow public->private only on a dedicated non-secret channel and never confer control.
- Separate Public/Private state is necessary but insufficient: a single shared revision leaks private event timing through public gaps. Require independent monotonic per-stream revisions (`controlRevision`, `audienceRevision`, perhaps `analysisRevision`) and atomic projection transaction IDs only server-side.
- Stage-local fullscreen activation is coherent only in a two-step flow. The proposed 'launcher turns itself into cross-origin Stage and pops Console' is impossible without navigation changing origin/state; after navigation it loses private app identity, while opener/COOP/auth assumptions become muddy. Drop it from MVP unless a fully specified same-document public shell proves noninterference.
- Mirrored bootstrap has an authority cycle if new phone approval requires an existing Console but the mirrored PC must never hold private credentials. Need a pre-presentation authenticated private device, or owner reauthentication through private origin plus an out-of-band approval policy. Otherwise no first controller exists. Make setup precondition explicit; fail closed rather than asking mirrored Stage to approve.
- `final STT + authoritative slide version` needs causal fields: utterance `{captureSessionId, audioSeqStart/end, finalizedAt}`, slide observation `{deckVersion, slideId, slideSeq, effectiveAt}`, and candidate `{sourceSlideSeq, transcriptFinalId, deckVersion, sourceRevision/hash, generatedAt}`. Define boundary policy for utterances spanning slide changes; otherwise nondeterministic fusion.
- Publication must bind to exact candidate inputs and current controller epoch; slide change after generation atomically makes candidate stale before approval.
- Takeover and pairing need linearizable CAS transitions, not merely epoch fields. Epoch increment + lease transfer + old session revocation must be one transaction.
- Offline fork: local slide movement may continue only as emergency Stage observation; reconnect reports absolute `(deckVersion, slideId, localSlideSeq)` and server chooses/records reconciliation. Never merge/replay relative commands.
- Missing version fields: protocol/schema cohort, public DTO schema version, deck asset hash, SW build ID, and snapshot stream watermark/tombstone retention.
Please challenge bootstrap resolution: I see no safe 'existing controller approves first private controller' path unless presentation preparation itself establishes controller authority.
